feat: show confirmed started conversations in price matrix (#139)

Expose confirmed FIRST_OFFER counts for today and the current calendar week and display them in a dedicated Price Matrix column alongside discovery metrics.

feat: base price matrix planning on actual weekly throughput (#140)

Measure completed-week conversation coverage against the exact observed opportunity set and derive bot recommendations from realised throughput instead of a fixed 35-conversations-per-week assumption.

feat: track unstarted queue and bot surplus (#141)

Reconstruct point-in-time unstarted queue snapshots from market observations and confirmed FIRST_OFFER audits, size the bot pool from realised queue trend, and expose a signed bot balance where negative values represent surplus bots.

revert: restore completed-week planning metrics (#142)

Remove reconstructed queue metrics and return Price Matrix planning to completed-week market observations, confirmed FIRST_OFFER coverage, and empirical weekly bot throughput.

feat: keep adaptive negotiation steps at hard cap

Clamp later adaptive negotiation steps to maxAutomaticOffer instead of ending the ladder, while preserving configured step progression and keeping first-offer hard-cap safety.

feat: add retrospective history outcome tags

Add manual history outcome labels for bookkeeping and statistics without changing technical listing status. Support retrospective relabeling, filters/counts, purchase-price correction for entries marked as purchased, and backfill existing purchases.

fix: exhaust offer candidates and align current market stats (#145)

Fix candidate fallback and current market stats

fix: close idle Playwright browsers between jobs

Close the whole Playwright browser runtime after each scheduled job while preserving each bot's persisted storageState session.

fix: make anonymous market observer self-healing

Ensure the market observer is always available as a credential-free internal identity, normalize legacy local database rows even when Flyway is disabled, and force Playwright to use the anonymous observer path instead of restoring stale observer sessions.

fix: handle nested Vinted category rows in observer

Keep semantic category lookup as the primary path, but fall back to exact visible-text matching when Vinted renders nested anonymous category rows without role=button. Preserve exact matching and final catalog[] URL verification.

fix: reopen bot session for manual CAPTCHA (#152)

Open a single headed recovery window for the affected bot when visible human verification is detected in a headless job, persist the same bot session, and retry the interrupted job once.
